page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head with page number at top; right margin holds a note "Cap. ȝ" (marginal reference) beside the first line; heading CAP. V. and subheading centred; a catchword-like signature "M 2 CAP;" at the foot.

main_text.p: ac liquores, quibus vel abluitur, vel dealbatur ? adeoque hunc esse Scripturarum in iftis Sen-sum, ut ex iis intelligamus nos à Christo spiri-tualiter pasci, ali, ac conservari, peccato in no-bis perempto liberari, animarum nostrarum nuditatem vera justitia tegi, corda nostra muni-ri, atque armari, sordes omnes abstergi, ac purgari. Ergo conclusum esto famosam il-lam transsubstantiationem, Romanæ religionis unicum longe nobilissimum mysterium, neq; in Scripturis legi, neque exiis intelligi: in qui-bus eam non mentis, quam corporis oculis atque sensibus deprehendere facilius sit.
main_text.head: CAP. V.
Eucharistiæ adorationem nusquam in Scripturis doceri.
main_text.p: VNde & hoc quoque necessario sequitur neque ex Scripturis probari posse hostiæ adorationem, totius Romani cultûs apicem; quæ transsubstantiatione, scilicet, velut uno fundamento, tota nititur. Neque enim substantiam panis ac vini accidentibus (ut in Scholis loquuntur) velatam adoraturi essent adversarii, si eam non corporis, ac sanguinis Domini-ci, sed panis, ac vini Eucharistici esse putarent.

page.notes: Marginal note at top right "Cap. ȝ" is a reference, partly damaged. Initial "V" of "VNde" is a large initial; read as V. Some words in the first paragraph are faint and may be imperfect. The bottom "CAP;" is a catchword-like mark at the foot and is uncertain.
